paper.title: UniIntervene: Agentic Intervention for Efficient Real-World Reinforcement Learning
paper.central_claim: UniIntervene, an agentic intervention model, detects unproductive exploration in real-world human-in-the-loop RL and autonomously recovers the policy toward high-value states, taking over the bulk of interventions from human operators: future-conditioned action-value estimation, a temporal value-risk critic that triggers on sustained stagnation or degradation, and retrieval of a high-value recovery target from a memory of past intervention episodes with a goal-conditioned recovery policy; improves average success rate by 8.6% while reducing human interventions by 57% relative to state-of-the-art HiL-RL baselines.
paper.scope_note: Aggregate ruling: out_of_scope (see assessment.scope_ruling). Seat scope_note (son55) flagged the same boundary.

evidence.quote: Extensive experiments on diverse real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate that UniIntervene improves the average success rate by 8.6% while reducing human interventions by 57% relative to state-of-the-art HiL-RL baselines.
neither line addresses the dominant source of human cost in HiL-RL: rollouts that are not unsafe yet fail to progress, leaving human takeover as the only resort
evidence.support_explanation: 作者的 gap 断言：'主导'的人工成本来自不安全但无进展的 rollouts——文中未提供干预原因构成的测量。
主结果：各任务 SR/IR 与均值。

evidence.quote: SR is measured over 20 evaluation episodes per task after training and reported as the percentage of successful episodes. IR is computed over three independent training runs as the ratio between the total number of intervention steps and the total number of robot interaction steps.
evidence.support_explanation: SR 每任务20个 episode；IR 为干预步数/总交互步数，跨三次训练但不报告方差。

evidence.quote: We ablate the key components of UniIntervene on Pick Eggplant and RAM Insertion
evidence.support_explanation: 消融仅在5个任务中的2个上进行。
消融表(Q-loss, Int. F1, SR, IR)。SR 差 5–10pp，对应2任务×20=40 episodes 中的 2–4 个。

evidence.quote: This also suggests that offline intervention F1 alone is insufficient to characterize recovery effectiveness
evidence.support_explanation: 作者承认：去掉未来预测/记忆目标时离线 F1 几乎不变(0.878/0.882 vs 0.882)，影响体现在在线 SR。

evidence.quote: We label intervention points offline by scanning the per-episode proxy value sequence, min-max normalized within each episode, with a sliding window of length 8
evidence.support_explanation: 触发头的标签由同一 proxy value 序列用规则挖掘；因此 'Int. F1' 是对由 proxy value 派生的标签的复现，而非对真实人工干预或真值进展的验证(循环)。

gap.author_gap: HiL-RL 仍是干预密集型：人需反复把策略从无效探索中拉回，劳动成本高；现有工作要么提高每次干预的数据利用，要么提高自主探索的安全/连续性，均不处理'不危险但无进展'的 rollouts。
gap.checked_gap: 局限真实且表述具体(干预时机外生于人；安全类触发与进展脱钩)，并与 HIL-SERL、FA-RL 同平台比较；'无进展 rollouts 是主导人工成本'未被测量支持。依据本文相关工作与基线附录，其他最近邻未本地核验。
gap.lineage: 祖先：HIL-SERL 等把人工纠正当监督(模仿/回放/残差/off-policy RL) → 近邻：失败预测+恢复(FA-RL)、重置免除、安全 critic → 本文：以价值趋势触发并检索高价值目标做自主恢复。

claims.text: UniIntervene 在真实 HiL-RL 中提高平均成功率并减少人工干预(摘要：SR +8.6%，人工干预 -57%)
claims.setting: UR7e，5任务，π0.5 策略，SpaceMouse 干预；HiL-SERL 为基线
claims.selection_vs_test: 训练后在同任务随机初态上20次评测；IR 为训练过程指标
claims.result_denominator: 平均 SR 54/81/77/88%；IR 34.3(HiL-SERL)/24.6(FA-RL)/14.6(UniIntervene)；SR 粒度5pp；100 vs 100 汇总 episodes 的 88 vs 81 差异 z≈1.37，Fisher 精确 p≈0.24
claims.counterevidence: 8.6% 为相对提升；SR 差统计上不显著；IR 是步比且分母含自主恢复步；先前 rollouts 的采集成本未计入；Pick Eggplant 上与 SFT 并列
claims.allowed_conclusion: 在该单机五任务设置下，IR 点估计显著低于基线(34.3→14.6)，SR 点估计略高；SR 提升未被统计证实，人工总成本未被证明降低。

claims.text: 价值趋势触发比失败预测更鲁棒，尤其在失败视觉上细微的任务
claims.selection_vs_test: 离线 F1 对 proxy value 派生标签
claims.result_denominator: 在线：FA-RL 在 RAM/Wipe 上 SR 75/80 低于 HiL-SERL 85/85
claims.counterevidence: F1 标签循环；FA-RL 基线多任务训练、口径不明
claims.allowed_conclusion: 在线结果与叙述方向一致，但离线触发准确性主张未被独立校验。

claims.text: 各组件(价值预测、TVR、未来预测、记忆目标)均有贡献
claims.counterevidence: 2/5 任务、差异为 2–4 个 episode；无启发式触发对照
claims.allowed_conclusion: 点估计与各组件有益的方向一致；样本太小，尚未证实各组件贡献。

claims.text: 恢复策略把停滞的 rollout 引回高价值状态而无需人工
claims.counterevidence: 无失败/误触发统计；人工仍介入
claims.allowed_conclusion: 仅有定性案例；无恢复成功率。

claims.text: 机制可跨操作类型迁移
claims.allowed_conclusion: 不支持跨本体/多任务部署迁移主张。

Whether the intervention/recovery stack and human takeover remain active during the 20 post-training SR evaluation episodes is not stated (agg:E008; raised by sol). If active, SR is a stack result, not a learner-only gain.

scope_ruling.reason: docs/EVIDENCE.md scope is anchored on a harness that wraps a frontier LLM/VLM or coding agent; the listed extensions (student training from harness/teacher trajectories, RL inside a harness or teacher-guided RL for a policy that runs in a harness, harness self-optimization, evaluation) all presuppose that harness. Exclusion: '没有 harness、agent loop、也不做教师-harness 蒸馏的纯 VLA / visuomotor 策略'. In UniIntervene: (i) the only VLMs are a LoRA-fine-tuned 2B backbone used as a feature extractor for learned heads (agg:E001) and a SigLIP+Gemma-270M proxy value net (agg:E002) - no frontier model is prompted or tool-called; (ii) the improved policy is a visuomotor policy trained by off-policy RL (agg:E003), not a policy running in a harness; (iii) the 'teacher' is a human SpaceMouse operator plus a learned BC recovery head (agg:E004), i.e. standard HiL-RL, not a harness teacher. The monitor/hand-back structure is analogous to K202/K603 (recorded in domain_pattern), but structural analogy to a domain card does not establish scope. Counter-argument considered: AGENTS.md excludes '无 harness/教师闭环的纯 VLA', which could be read as admitting any teacher loop; that reading would admit all human-in-the-loop RL/DAgger robot learning, contradicting the project definition ('harness 教师轨迹蒸馏、on-policy 纠正、harness 内 RL'). Ruling: out_of_scope. The resolved analysis is kept and an audit-only conditional score is recorded in case the user reverses the scope rule.

holdout.reason: 评测为训练后在同一任务(随机化物体位姿)上的新 episode，未宣称泛化；但无留出任务/物体/本体，检索质量仅在训练 rollouts 上审计，proxy value/记忆的数据来源与评测任务的重叠不明，主张范围(多样真实任务)超出单本体5个桌面任务。介于0与2之间取1。

initial_evidence_judgment: Read in full before seat reasons. UniIntervene adds a learned intervention module to real-world HiL-RL: a Qwen3-VL-2B (LoRA) backbone with a V-JEPA2-supervised future head, a twin value head regressing a frozen SigLIP+Gemma-270M proxy value (NTTG time-progress labels), a temporal value-risk trigger, and a retrieval-goal -conditioned BC recovery head (FAST tokens); the learner is a pi0.5-SFT-initialized visuomotor policy updated by HIL-SERL off-policy RL with a human SpaceMouse teacher. Key result: 5 real UR7e tasks, 20 eval episodes/task, SR 81->88 (relative +8.6%, +7 pp) and step-intervention rate 34.3%->14.6% vs HIL-SERL; 2-task ablations. Evidence is online-only (same tasks, single embodiment), point estimates without variance, trigger F1 measured against labels mined from the same proxy value, and it is not stated whether the intervention stack is active at evaluation. Scope: no frontier LLM/VLM or coding agent in any role (policy, monitor, teacher) and the improved policy does not run inside a harness; this is a HiL-RL training-efficiency method for a visuomotor policy.

resolutions.reason: Both agree on the primary and on sub=null (C07/C08/C26 tactics do not match). Rejected supporting adapt_via_conditioning: its operation is task generalization by conditioning instead of per-task retraining; here the recovery head is itself trained by BC on segments of the same tasks, retrieval is from per-task memories behind an instruction router, and no new-task generalization is claimed or tested. Goal-conditioning is an internal design detail of a trained policy, not a distinct operation needing a supporting card (PATTERN_PROTOCOL step 3).

M anchor 2 = concrete mechanism with partial causal explanation and weak key assumptions. Weak assumptions on the method's own logic: progress supervision is time-linear NTTG labels (agg:E007); trigger labels use per-episode min-max normalization that is not causally available online (agg:E006); the stated reason for future-conditioning (a more stable trigger signal) is not borne out by its own ablation on trigger F1 (agg:E005). Distinguishing predictions vs instantaneous-threshold and failure-prediction triggers exist (w/o TVR, FA-RL), which keeps M at 2 not lower. sol's own reason concedes 'monotone-time proxy and reachability remain weak assumptions', which matches anchor 2, not 3.

K603's operation (gate flags learner states -> corrector acts -> transitions train the learner) is executed: trigger fires, recovery chunk executes, recovery transitions enter the replay buffer used for off-policy RL (agg:E003). The corrector is a learned BC head, not a frontier/privileged teacher, and teacher removal at evaluation is unknown (agg:E008) - recorded as failed/unknown conditions with fit partial_weak rather than excluding the closest structural analogue. sol's objection is retained as condition evidence.
FA-RL is an alternative loop organization, but proxy/backbone/recovery data and compute differ from HIL-SERL, so it is not a same-budget harness toggle.
Expectation requires run-to-run variance/paired statistics; IR is pooled over 3 runs with no variance and SR is a single 20-episode evaluation; nothing satisfies the requirement.
Only the intervention-step ratio is reported; no latency, compute, wall-clock or failed-trial cost. IR is the claimed outcome, not the cost report the expectation asks for.

Development/eval overlap is evident from the text (memory and proxy built from rollouts of the same 5 tasks, single embodiment disclosed); provenance of the prior rollouts is not. Partial disclosure, not unknown.
